info.title: Lingo API
info.summary: Backend for a Duolingo-inspired language-learning app.

get.summary: Course detail with the learner's lesson count
Learning path: units and skills with the learner's status
Skill with its lessons and their status
Lesson exercises for play (never includes solutions)

post.summary: Start a lesson attempt, or resume the active one
post.description: 201 when a new attempt is created, 200 when the in-progress attempt is resumed.

409.description: Conflict with the current state (e.g. OUT_OF_HEARTS)
Conflict with the current state (e.g. OUT_OF_HEARTS)

get.summary: XP, daily goal, streak and course progress summary

post.summary: Complete a lesson attempt and receive rewards (idempotent)

409.description: Conflict with the current state (e.g. OUT_OF_HEARTS)
Conflict with the current state (e.g. OUT_OF_HEARTS)

submission_id.title: Submission Id
submission_id.description: Client-generated id (e.g. UUID). Retrying with the same id is safe.

correct_answer.title: Correct Answer
correct_answer.description: Revealed only after the answer has been checked.

note.title: Note
note.description: Soft feedback, e.g. an accent reminder.

unlocked_skill_id.title: Unlocked Skill Id
unlocked_skill_id.description: Skill unlocked by this completion, if any.

CompleteLessonOut.title: CompleteLessonOut
CompleteLessonOut.description: Result of a completion. Repeating the request returns the same body.

CurrentUserOut.title: CurrentUserOut
CurrentUserOut.description: Identity plus everything the top stats bar needs, in one request.

next_heart_at.title: Next Heart At
next_heart_at.description: When the next heart regenerates; null if full.

LessonOut.title: LessonOut
LessonOut.description: Everything needed to render a lesson — and nothing that reveals an answer.

current.title: Current
current.description: Displayed streak (0 once a day has been missed).

active_today.title: Active Today
active_today.description: Whether a lesson was completed today.
